candidate_dataset_comparison.fit: Selected: public food/product catalog with barcode, product name, category, and package quantity fields that naturally exercise the ERPNext Item and Item Price contract.
candidate_dataset_comparison.license: ODbL database; Database Contents License for individual contents.
candidate_dataset_comparison.name: Open Food Facts

candidate_dataset_comparison.fit: Considered but not selected: excellent public food-composition source, CC0/public-domain data, but its core fields are nutrition-composition oriented and provide fewer natural links to the existing product-and-pricing target contract without inventing target semantics.
candidate_dataset_comparison.name: USDA FoodData Central

sampling.method: Query Open Food Facts search API sorted by unique_scans_n, then keep the first 24 products with non-empty code, product_name, quantity, and categories.
sampling.source_value_normalization: none; API values are written as returned, except CSV escaping performed by Python csv module

source_name: Open Food Facts product search API
